short: 'It can help' (with anxiety, in people) is not carried: its words are another group's ranking of plants used for anxiety, a finding in zebrafish larvae and a behaviour test with no people in it
'Yes' (mothers worry) says more than the NHS's 'may feel worried', said of the families of someone who uses drugs; 'youth' is not in its words
'It can affect bone growth' makes a cause of what the source says caffeine 'has been related to' (abnormal bone growth)
'when laced with other substances': its words speak of mixing meth with alcohol and with other drugs, not of meth that is laced
'No' (people who use LSD share no traits) is not carried: its words speak of how LSD's effects vary between people, not of who uses it
'datura is very addictive': its words say 'They are very addictive', of several plants in a review, and do not name datura
